Tribunal

Queue

dev-v2-ext · Case 2732

No-show fee

I was there, he cancelled, charged $4.50.

Filed by
Rider
Amount contested
SGD 4.50
Status
Sent to a reviewer: the judge escalated under the policy JUDGE_ESCALATE

No automated ruling was issued. A human reviewer decides this case.

Ruling

Why a reviewer: the judge escalated under the policy JUDGE_ESCALATE

No money moves. The disputed amount is held.

A reviewer decides within 24 hours of entry, or within 2 hours when the case carries a safety flag.

Escalation is terminal: no monetary outcome issues, so there is nothing for POL-GEN-05 to execute and the disputed amount is held rather than collected or refunded.

What each side argued

The rider advocate

kept The waiting period this trip must be measured against is 180 seconds, not 300. TRP-02732's platform_policy carries free_wait_sec 180, and the fee schedule's resolution rule reads the figure in force from platform_policy first; the 300-second STANDARD minimum_dwell_sec is retained only to interpret records authored before policy version 2 and is never applied to a record that carries platform_policy, which this one does. The driver therefore had to hold position inside the geofence for a continuous three minutes before the RIDER_NO_SHOW termination at 17:13:20 could be chargeable.

evidence EV-TRIP-02732 · clauses POL-NS-01

kept The waiting clock cannot be read off the driver's own arrival tap. platform_policy.arrival_marker on this trip is BUTTON, a driver-pressed marker, and POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, expressly not from the arrived event; POL-NS-12's platform-confirmed treatment covers only GPS_AUTO arrivals and says a BUTTON marker is not covered. The 6.7 minutes in trip_record.wait_time_min is simply the difference between that tap and the cancellation, so it is not a measurement of in-geofence dwell and cannot supply the seconds the trace is missing. (The GPS trace cited here is impaired: weight 0.39, issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE.)

evidence EV-TRIP-02732, EV-GPS-02732 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-12

kept Measured on the GPS clock, the effective in-geofence dwell falls 35 seconds short of the minimum. The trace's own derived runs show a longest unbroken qualifying run of 145 seconds (17:10:51 to 17:13:16, 15 fixes) and an earlier in-geofence stretch of only 60 seconds (17:06:36 to 17:07:36, 7 fixes), so no continuous 180-second dwell exists, the shortfall is 35 seconds, and POL-NS-06 requires the cancellation fee to be refunded in full regardless of where the rider was. The driver's chat assertion that he 'waited the full time' is not corroborated by any measured run. The trace is impaired — weight 0.39, issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE — and I take the shortfall from the trace's own derived numbers rather than presenting impaired evidence as clean.

evidence EV-GPS-02732 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-NS-01

kept The 400-second longest_qualifying_run cannot be used to close that shortfall in the driver's favour. It runs from 17:06:36 to 17:13:16 and straddles the 195-second sampling hole from 17:07:36 to 17:10:51, during which the trace records no fix at all; those 195 seconds are unmeasured, not waited, which is precisely the situation POL-NS-08(b) treats as a policy-level defect when the gap inside the waiting window exceeds 120 seconds. Read as a continuous dwell the figure asserts the very continuity the trace cannot show, and it counts a hole as presence. (Trace impaired: weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE.)

evidence EV-GPS-02732 · clauses POL-NS-08, POL-NS-01

discarded The two in-geofence intervals cannot be added together to manufacture 180 seconds. POL-NS-06(i) permits accumulation only where a present and populated traffic_advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covers the pickup road and the waiting window, such that holding position was not lawfully possible; EV-ADVIS-02732-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 — no advisory covers Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres in this window — so limb (i) is unavailable and the 60-second and 145-second intervals may not be summed, leaving the longest continuous stretch at 145 seconds. I cite the absent advisory for its absence, not for any content it does not have. (The GPS trace is impaired: weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE.)

evidence EV-ADVIS-02732-01, EV-GPS-02732 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-GEN-02

Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-ADVIS-02732-01 at weight_multiplier 0.0 but does not name its issue code(s): MISSING_ARTIFACT

kept POL-NS-01 is conjunctive: all four limbs must hold or the fee is not chargeable at all. Three of them are on the record — an arrived event, qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius under POL-NS-02, and a driver termination recorded as RIDER_NO_SHOW — but limb (c) fails, because a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period in force was not held. A no-show fee cannot be built on the one limb the evidence does not carry, and where a limb fails the refund is fixed by POL-NS-06. (The GPS trace cited is impaired: weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE.)

evidence EV-TRIP-02732, EV-GPS-02732 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02, POL-NS-06

kept The sum to be returned is the cancellation-fee line and nothing else. EV-FARE-02732 shows cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the whole contested SGD 4.50 is still live and falls to be refunded under POL-NS-06; that clause allows no driver compensation where the dwell falls short, so the refund is not netted against any driver payment and no booking or platform fee arises on a trip that never ran.

evidence EV-FARE-02732 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-GEN-03

discarded In the alternative, if the Judge concludes that the effective dwell cannot be measured at all, the correct outcome is still not to leave the SGD 4.50 collected. POL-NS-08's closing sentence provides that where the only evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under its limbs (a) to (d) the ruling may not exceed PARTIAL_REFUND and the case escalates under POL-NS-09; the 195-second gap engages limb (b), and the trace's schema weight of 0.39 sits far below the 0.70 confidence floor of POL-NS-09(a). Escalation is terminal and the disputed fee is held rather than collected, so on either route — refund or escalation — the rider does not end up bearing a charge that the driver's own trace cannot support.

evidence EV-GPS-02732 · clauses POL-NS-08, POL-NS-09, POL-GEN-02

Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-02732 at weight_multiplier 0.39 but does not name its issue code(s): GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE

The driver advocate

kept The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event for this trip at 2026-09-03 17:06:36 at Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres, zone class STANDARD, so limb (a) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the platform's own record.

evidence EV-TRIP-02732 · clauses POL-NS-01

kept The driver's own trace places him inside the STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m from the first qualifying fix at 17:06:36, with min_distance_m 0.157 m and 22 qualifying in-radius fixes — far more than the 3 consecutive fixes POL-NS-02 demands — so limb (b) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied. This trace is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, and I rely on it with that discount disclosed.

evidence EV-GPS-02732 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02

kept The derived arrival block puts the driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run at 400 seconds, from 17:06:36 to 17:13:16, well past the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec 180), so limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is met and the driver's own statement that he waited the full time is borne out by the telemetry. The underlying trace is impaired — weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE — and I disclose that.

evidence EV-GPS-02732, EV-TRIP-02732 · clauses POL-NS-01

kept The 195-second sampling gap from 17:07:36 to 17:10:51 is a sampling gap, not a departure: the fixes bracketing it are 0.0 km apart in a straight line, so the trace shows the driver held the same point while the sampler was silent. That gap is exactly the GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW impairment on EV-GPS-02732 (weight 0.39) which I have disclosed, and it does not contradict the continuous in-geofence dwell.

evidence EV-GPS-02732 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-08

discarded The dwell does not rest on the impaired trace alone: the trip record independently bounds the wait from the 17:06:36 arrival event to the 17:13:20 driver termination, a 404-second interval with no boarding event recorded. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the deciding fact is therefore carried by two independent artifacts, and the confidence cap is the maximum of their weights — the trip record's 1.0 — not the trace's 0.39.

evidence EV-TRIP-02732, EV-GPS-02732 · clauses POL-GEN-02

Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-02732 at weight_multiplier 0.39 but does not name its issue code(s): GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE

kept The trip record shows the trip terminated by the driver under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW at 17:13:20, at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed, and records no boarding event — limb (d) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on one of the three reason codes the clause recognises.

evidence EV-TRIP-02732 · clauses POL-NS-01

kept The arrival marker was not false: the first qualifying run records 7 in-geofence fixes across the 60 seconds from 17:06:36 with the driver stationary at the pin, so at the marker he was neither more than 300 m away nor travelling at 15 km/h or more, and POL-NS-05 is not engaged. The trace carrying this is impaired (weight 0.39; GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE) and I disclose it.

evidence EV-GPS-02732, EV-TRIP-02732 · clauses POL-NS-05

kept The rider's exoneration route under POL-NS-04 cannot run at all: the chat log for this trip carries 0 messages and the trip record records no in-app calls, so limb (a) — a locating or coordinating message sent by the rider during the waiting window — is not met, and the silence interval limb (b) turns on never arises.

evidence EV-CHAT-02732, EV-TRIP-02732 · clauses POL-NS-04

discarded The trace carries no rider track at all — rider_fix_count 0, rider_presence.available false — so POL-NS-04 limb (c) is undecidable rather than failed, and under POL-NS-11 that undecidability cannot exonerate the rider; nor does the absent rider track impair the driver's own arrival and dwell evidence for POL-NS-01.

evidence EV-GPS-02732 · clauses POL-NS-11

Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-02732 at weight_multiplier 0.39 but does not name its issue code(s): GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE

discarded POL-NS-06's shortfall trigger does not engage: it fires only where the effective in-geofence dwell falls below the 180-second minimum, and on the primary arrival measure the dwell is 400 seconds. The separate accumulated-dwell block is the POL-NS-06 limb (i) accumulation tool and is unavailable on these facts, but the driver does not need it and does not assert it.

evidence EV-GPS-02732 · clauses POL-NS-06

Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-GPS-02732 at weight_multiplier 0.39 but does not name its issue code(s): GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE

kept The fare ledger is clean and shows no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect: its cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 reconciles exactly with trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50, payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00 — so the fee the driver is asked to defend is the correct net figure.

evidence EV-FARE-02732, EV-TRIP-02732 · clauses POL-NS-08

kept With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee — SGD 3.60 — and the anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the clause requires, and 1 of 81 completed trips is far below the 0.08 ratio.

evidence EV-FARE-02732, EV-DPROF-02732, EV-TRIP-02732 · clauses POL-NS-07

kept The outcome this record produces is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, not NO_ACTION: where compensation is paid the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd, and the rider's charge simply stands as the disposition of the fee under POL-NS-07. Reading POL-NS-07's 'the ruling on the fee is NO_ACTION' as the ruling value would be a misreading of POL-GEN-03.

evidence EV-FARE-02732 · clauses POL-GEN-03, POL-NS-07

Rider and driver: this case goes to a human reviewer, and the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is held — not collected and not refunded — until that review is done. I could not decide it on this record, and the reason is a hole in the one piece of evidence that matters. Both sides agree the fee turns on POL-NS-01(c): did the driver hold position inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a continuous dwell of at least the 180 seconds in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180)? The arrival tap at 17:06:36 is a BUTTON marker, not a platform-confirmed GPS_AUTO arrival, so POL-NS-12 does not apply, and POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the tap. The dwell can therefore only be read from EV-GPS-02732. That trace is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE (POL-GEN-02(1)). It carries a 195-second sampling gap from 17:07:36 to 17:10:51 inside the waiting window, which is a policy-level impairment under POL-NS-08(b). The driver's reading and the rider's reading both depend on that gap, and the trace cannot settle either. The driver points to the 400-second longest_qualifying_run (17:06:36–17:13:16, 22 fixes); but that span contains the 195 unmeasured seconds, and calling it a continuous dwell asserts the very continuity the trace cannot show. The rider points to the two admitted in-geofence runs (60 s and 145 s) and a 35-second shortfall against 180 s; but to make 145 s the ceiling the rider must treat the gap as no dwell, and the trace cannot show the driver left and re-entered either — the fixes bracketing the gap are 0.0 km apart, so the excursion is unmeasurable. POL-NS-06(i), the only route that would let the two intervals be summed, is unavailable: no traffic_advisory is present (EV-ADVIS-02732-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0). So limb (c) is undecided over the stretch the defect covers. It is not satisfied, so the fee cannot stand and POL-NS-07 cannot fix the SGD 3.60 payout; and it is not failed, so POL-NS-06 cannot refund the SGD 4.50. The in-geofence dwell — the deciding fact — rests on this single impaired trace. Nothing independent carries it: the chat log has 0 messages, and the trip record and fare ledger carry the arrived event, the RIDER_NO_SHOW termination and the clean SGD 4.50 line, but not the dwell. POL-NS-08's closing sentence and POL-NS-09(e) therefore escalate the case, and the confidence is capped at the trace's 0.39, below the 0.70 floor, which engages POL-NS-09(a) as well. Accepted on the record: the arrived event (limb a) and the RIDER_NO_SHOW termination with no boarding (limb d), both on the clean trip record; the qualifying in-radius fixes (limb b); POL-NS-05 is not engaged, because the arrival marker was not false — the driver was at the pin and stationary at 17:06:36; the empty chat log means POL-NS-04 cannot run, and the absent rider track leaves rider presence undecidable under POL-NS-11 rather than exonerating the rider; and the fare ledger's SGD 4.50 line reconciles with the fee in force and discloses no POL-NS-08(d) defect. Open question for the reviewer: across the 195-second gap, was the driver continuously inside the 50 m radius (a mere sampling gap), or did he leave and return (a departure)? If the dwell is continuous, POL-NS-01 holds, the charge stands and POL-NS-07 pays the driver SGD 3.60. If it is broken, the dwell is 145 s, 35 s short of the 180 s minimum, and POL-NS-06 refunds the rider the SGD 4.50.
To both parties: this is a SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged to the rider on trip TRP-02732 and still live on EV-FARE-02732 (cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). A no-show fee stands only if POL-NS-01 is satisfied in all four limbs; the rider wins by breaking any one. I accept limbs (a), (b) and (d). EV-TRIP-02732 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 17:06:36 (a); the trace places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 17:06:36, with 22 qualifying in-geofence fixes and min_distance_m 0.157, which is the POL-NS-02 test (b); and the trip terminated by the driver under RIDER_NO_SHOW at 17:13:20 with no boarding event (d). The fare ledger reconciles (4.50 = platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50), so the figure in dispute is the correct net amount. The case turns on limb (c), the continuous in-geofence dwell of at least the free waiting period in force - 180 s, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec; the 300 s STANDARD minimum_dwell_sec applies only to pre-version-2 records and not to this one. The dwell is measured from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the driver's 'arrived' tap (POL-NS-01(c)); the tap here is BUTTON, so POL-NS-12's platform-confirmed (GPS_AUTO) treatment does not apply, and trip_record.wait_time_min 6.7 is only the tap-to-cancellation interval, not an in-geofence dwell measurement. The only evidence for that dwell is EV-GPS-02732, and it is impaired. Its admissibility weight is 0.39, with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE. Its own derived figures conflict: longest_qualifying_run reports 400 s (17:06:36-17:13:16, 22 fixes), but the underlying run list is 60 s (17:06:36-17:07:36) and 145 s (17:10:51-17:13:16), with longest_run_sec 145 and a stated shortfall of 35 s. The 400 s figure spans a 195 s sampling hole from 17:07:36 to 17:10:51 inside the waiting window, and a gap longer than 120 s inside the waiting window makes the trace impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08(b). Against the driver: the 400 s dwell is rejected. It counts the unobserved 195 s as presence. The only route to join the 60 s and 145 s intervals is POL-NS-06(i), which requires a present and populated traffic advisory of a qualifying type; EV-ADVIS-02732-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0), so limb (i) is unavailable, the intervals may not be summed, and the trace's own excursion block records the stretch as unmeasurable. Without it, no observed continuous run reaches 180 s, and the driver's 3.60 payout under POL-NS-07 (80% of 4.50) cannot be fixed. Against the rider: the full refund is not supported either. The trace does not show the driver leaving the geofence; it simply fails to observe him for 195 s. The limb therefore cannot be affirmed, and because the gap is unobserved it cannot be denied either - limb (c) is UNDECIDED over the impaired stretch, and an undecided limb supports neither the fee nor the refund. The rider's other routes do not help. POL-NS-04 cannot run (EV-CHAT-02732 carries 0 messages; no in-app calls), and the absent rider track makes its limb (c) undecidable; under POL-NS-11 that is neutral, does not exonerate the rider and does not impair the driver's arrival and dwell evidence. POL-NS-05 is not engaged - at the 'arrived' timestamp the driver was at the pin, not more than 300 m away and not at 15 km/h or more - so no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-03 does not apply: the stationary fixes are inside the arrival radius, not outside it. The case therefore escalates. The sole evidence for the deciding fact - the continuous in-geofence dwell - is impaired under POL-NS-08(b), which engages POL-NS-09(e); and confidence, capped by that sole carrier at 0.39, is below the 0.70 floor, engaging POL-NS-09(a). Escalation is terminal: no monetary ruling issues, and the SGD 4.50 fee is HELD rather than collected or refunded while review is pending. POL-GEN-05 is not reached because the monetary effect is nil. Open question for the reviewer: on the full-resolution telemetry, did the driver hold position inside the 50 m geofence continuously for at least the 180 s free waiting period before cancelling at 17:13:20 - the answer turning on the 195 s hole from 17:07:36 to 17:10:51? The reviewer may request a full-resolution GPS export as record-type evidence under POL-GEN-04(b). The escalation packet carries both advocate briefs, the pre-pass report, the clauses relied on (POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05, POL-NS-06, POL-NS-07, POL-NS-08, POL-NS-09, POL-NS-11, POL-GEN-02) and this reasoning. No clause-mandated referral fires on these facts (the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d 1, below 4, and 1/81 well under 0.08).
To both parties: this dispute cannot be decided automatically, so I am sending it to a human reviewer. The contested $4.50 no-show fee is placed on hold — neither collected nor refunded — until that review is complete. What is not in dispute. The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 17:06:36 and records the trip terminated by the driver at 17:13:20 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event, so POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) hold. The driver's trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 17:06:36 (22 qualifying fixes, minimum distance 0.157 m), so limb (b) holds and the arrival marker is not a false one — POL-NS-05 is not engaged, and no false-arrival record arises. The fare ledger is clean: its $4.50 cancellation-fee line reconciles with the policy figure in force, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd $0.00. The chat log carries 0 messages and no in-app calls, so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider. On those points the driver's account is correct. The one contested limb. POL-NS-01 is conjunctive, and limb (c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least the free waiting period in force — 180 seconds on this trip. POL-NS-01(c) measures that dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, expressly not from the 'arrived' event, and the arrival marker here is BUTTON (driver-pressed), so POL-NS-12's platform-confirmed treatment does not apply and the trip record's wait_time_min of 6.7 minutes cannot supply it. On the GPS clock the trace shows only two continuous in-geofence stretches: 60 seconds (17:06:36–17:07:36) and 145 seconds (17:10:51–17:13:16). Neither reaches 180 seconds, and POL-NS-06(i) accumulation across them is unavailable because it requires a present and populated traffic_advisory, and EV-ADVIS-02732-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0). The obstruction is the 195-second sampling gap from 17:07:36 to 17:10:51, inside the waiting window. That exceeds the 120 seconds POL-NS-08(b) sets as a policy-level trace defect, so EV-GPS-02732 is impaired on that limb (it also carries a LOW_COVERAGE pre-pass tag) at weight_multiplier 0.39. The two fixes bracketing the gap are 0.0 km apart in a straight line, which shows only that the driver was at the same place before and after — not that he stayed inside the arrival radius throughout, so the gap is unmeasured time. Accordingly the driver's 400-second 'longest qualifying run', which spans the gap, cannot be read as a continuous dwell, and the rider's asserted 35-second shortfall cannot be read as a definite shortfall either, because the same gap could conceal a continuous stretch. Limb (c) is undecided over the gap, and an undecided limb supports neither a fee that needs the clause to hold nor a refund that needs it to fail. The driver's request for $3.60 compensation under POL-NS-07 is therefore not reached, and the rider's request for a $4.50 refund under POL-NS-06 is not reached. Why review. The dwell is the deciding fact, and the only artifact that measures it is EV-GPS-02732, impaired under POL-NS-08(b) at weight 0.39. No independent artifact carries that fact: the trip record fixes the endpoints but not the continuity, and the driver's statement that he 'waited the full time' is a party account that POL-NS-01(c) does not read. Confidence is therefore capped at 0.39, below the 0.70 floor, and the sole-evidence condition of POL-NS-08's closing sentence and POL-NS-09(e) is met — so the case escalates under POL-NS-09(a) and (e), and nothing here turns on the anti-farming check, which does not trip (1 no-show termination against 81 completed trips in 30 days). Open question for the reviewer: using the platform's full-resolution stream rather than the exported trace, determine whether the driver remained inside the 50 m arrival radius continuously from 17:06:36 to 17:13:20. If he did, the fee stands at $4.50 and the driver's payout is $3.60 under POL-NS-07; if he did not, the fee is refunded in full under POL-NS-06 with no driver compensation.
Rider and driver: the SGD 4.50 no-show fee on trip TRP-02732 is placed on hold and the case goes to a human reviewer. The fee turns on one question — did the driver hold position inside the pickup geofence continuously for the 180-second free waiting period in force (EV-TRIP-02732 platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180 s) before cancelling at 17:13:20 under RIDER_NO_SHOW? Limbs (a), (b) and (d) of POL-NS-01 are on the record: the driver-arrived event at 17:06:36, 22 qualifying in-radius fixes on EV-GPS-02732 (STANDARD arrival radius 50 m), and the driver's RIDER_NO_SHOW termination, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises. Limb (c) cannot be decided. The only measurement of in-geofence dwell is EV-GPS-02732, and that trace is impaired at weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE: it carries a 195-second sampling hole from 17:07:36 to 17:10:51 — longer than the 120-second threshold that makes a trace defective under POL-NS-08(b) — and reports only 80.5% coverage. Outside the hole the admitted readings show a longest continuous in-geofence run of 145 seconds (17:10:51-17:13:16), with a 60-second run before the hole; the derived 400-second 'longest_qualifying_run' spans the hole and so cannot show continuity across it. The only route to 180 continuous seconds runs through the unmeasured stretch, so the limb is undecided: it is not affirmatively met, so the driver's claim to a 400-second dwell is not established; and a 35-second shortfall is not affirmatively proved either, so the rider's POL-NS-06 refund is not established. The accumulation route in POL-NS-06(i) cannot help either side because EV-ADVIS-02732-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0). Because the sole evidence for this deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08, the ruling may not exceed PARTIAL_REFUND and escalates under POL-NS-09; and the POL-GEN-02(2) cap on confidence is the trace's 0.39, below the 0.70 floor, which also escalates under POL-NS-09(a). No monetary outcome issues and the SGD 4.50 stays on hold, neither collected nor refunded. On the parties' claims: the driver's limbs (a), (b) and (d) points are accepted, the arrival marker was not false so POL-NS-05 is not engaged, POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider (EV-CHAT-02732 carries 0 messages and no in-app calls), and the fare ledger is clean with no POL-NS-08(d) defect (its SGD 4.50 line reconciles with platform_policy) — but the 400-second dwell claim is rejected for the reason above, so POL-NS-07 cannot fix the SGD 3.60 payout and the DRIVER_COMPENSATION outcome is not available; the driver's statement that he 'waited the full time' is his own assertion, carries no weight multiplier and names no clause test, so it neither lifts the confidence cap nor carries the dwell. The rider's points that the period is 180 s and not 300, that dwell must be read on the GPS clock rather than the 17:06:36 arrival tap (arrival_marker is BUTTON, so POL-NS-12 does not apply), and that the 400-second figure cannot bridge the hole are accepted — but the 35-second shortfall and the consequent full refund under POL-NS-06 rest on the same impaired trace and are not affirmatively established, so no refund issues. The open question for the reviewer is whether the driver remained at the pin through the 17:07:36-17:10:51 hole; a full-resolution GPS export covering that window would settle it.

The advocate briefs, as the packet carries them

  • RIDER: The waiting period this trip must be measured against is 180 seconds, not 300. TRP-02732's platform_policy carries free_wait_sec 180, and the fee schedule's resolution rule reads the figure in force from platform_policy first; the 300-second STANDARD minimum_dwell_sec is retained only to interpret records authored before policy version 2 and is never applied to a record that carries platform_policy, which this one does. The driver therefore had to hold position inside the geofence for a continuous three minutes before the RIDER_NO_SHOW termination at 17:13:20 could be chargeable. KEPT; The waiting clock cannot be read off the driver's own arrival tap. platform_policy.arrival_marker on this trip is BUTTON, a driver-pressed marker, and POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, expressly not from the arrived event; POL-NS-12's platform-confirmed treatment covers only GPS_AUTO arrivals and says a BUTTON marker is not covered. The 6.7 minutes in trip_record.wait_time_min is simply the difference between that tap and the cancellation, so it is not a measurement of in-geofence dwell and cannot supply the seconds the trace is missing. (The GPS trace cited here is impaired: weight 0.39, issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE.) KEPT; Measured on the GPS clock, the effective in-geofence dwell falls 35 seconds short of the minimum. The trace's own derived runs show a longest unbroken qualifying run of 145 seconds (17:10:51 to 17:13:16, 15 fixes) and an earlier in-geofence stretch of only 60 seconds (17:06:36 to 17:07:36, 7 fixes), so no continuous 180-second dwell exists, the shortfall is 35 seconds, and POL-NS-06 requires the cancellation fee to be refunded in full regardless of where the rider was. The driver's chat assertion that he 'waited the full time' is not corroborated by any measured run. The trace is impaired — weight 0.39, issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE — and I take the shortfall from the trace's own derived numbers rather than presenting impaired evidence as clean. KEPT; The 400-second longest_qualifying_run cannot be used to close that shortfall in the driver's favour. It runs from 17:06:36 to 17:13:16 and straddles the 195-second sampling hole from 17:07:36 to 17:10:51, during which the trace records no fix at all; those 195 seconds are unmeasured, not waited, which is precisely the situation POL-NS-08(b) treats as a policy-level defect when the gap inside the waiting window exceeds 120 seconds. Read as a continuous dwell the figure asserts the very continuity the trace cannot show, and it counts a hole as presence. (Trace impaired: weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE.) KEPT; The two in-geofence intervals cannot be added together to manufacture 180 seconds. POL-NS-06(i) permits accumulation only where a present and populated traffic_advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covers the pickup road and the waiting window, such that holding position was not lawfully possible; EV-ADVIS-02732-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 — no advisory covers Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres in this window — so limb (i) is unavailable and the 60-second and 145-second intervals may not be summed, leaving the longest continuous stretch at 145 seconds. I cite the absent advisory for its absence, not for any content it does not have. (The GPS trace is impaired: weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE.) DISCARDED; POL-NS-01 is conjunctive: all four limbs must hold or the fee is not chargeable at all. Three of them are on the record — an arrived event, qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius under POL-NS-02, and a driver termination recorded as RIDER_NO_SHOW — but limb (c) fails, because a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period in force was not held. A no-show fee cannot be built on the one limb the evidence does not carry, and where a limb fails the refund is fixed by POL-NS-06. (The GPS trace cited is impaired: weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE.) KEPT; The sum to be returned is the cancellation-fee line and nothing else. EV-FARE-02732 shows cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the whole contested SGD 4.50 is still live and falls to be refunded under POL-NS-06; that clause allows no driver compensation where the dwell falls short, so the refund is not netted against any driver payment and no booking or platform fee arises on a trip that never ran. KEPT; In the alternative, if the Judge concludes that the effective dwell cannot be measured at all, the correct outcome is still not to leave the SGD 4.50 collected. POL-NS-08's closing sentence provides that where the only evidence for the deciding fact is impaired under its limbs (a) to (d) the ruling may not exceed PARTIAL_REFUND and the case escalates under POL-NS-09; the 195-second gap engages limb (b), and the trace's schema weight of 0.39 sits far below the 0.70 confidence floor of POL-NS-09(a). Escalation is terminal and the disputed fee is held rather than collected, so on either route — refund or escalation — the rider does not end up bearing a charge that the driver's own trace cannot support. DISCARDED
  • DRIVER: The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event for this trip at 2026-09-03 17:06:36 at Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres, zone class STANDARD, so limb (a) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the platform's own record. KEPT; The driver's own trace places him inside the STANDARD arrival radius of 50 m from the first qualifying fix at 17:06:36, with min_distance_m 0.157 m and 22 qualifying in-radius fixes — far more than the 3 consecutive fixes POL-NS-02 demands — so limb (b) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied. This trace is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, and I rely on it with that discount disclosed. KEPT; The derived arrival block puts the driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run at 400 seconds, from 17:06:36 to 17:13:16, well past the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec 180), so limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is met and the driver's own statement that he waited the full time is borne out by the telemetry. The underlying trace is impaired — weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE — and I disclose that. KEPT; The 195-second sampling gap from 17:07:36 to 17:10:51 is a sampling gap, not a departure: the fixes bracketing it are 0.0 km apart in a straight line, so the trace shows the driver held the same point while the sampler was silent. That gap is exactly the GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW impairment on EV-GPS-02732 (weight 0.39) which I have disclosed, and it does not contradict the continuous in-geofence dwell. KEPT; The dwell does not rest on the impaired trace alone: the trip record independently bounds the wait from the 17:06:36 arrival event to the 17:13:20 driver termination, a 404-second interval with no boarding event recorded. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the deciding fact is therefore carried by two independent artifacts, and the confidence cap is the maximum of their weights — the trip record's 1.0 — not the trace's 0.39. DISCARDED; The trip record shows the trip terminated by the driver under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW at 17:13:20, at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed, and records no boarding event — limb (d) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on one of the three reason codes the clause recognises. KEPT; The arrival marker was not false: the first qualifying run records 7 in-geofence fixes across the 60 seconds from 17:06:36 with the driver stationary at the pin, so at the marker he was neither more than 300 m away nor travelling at 15 km/h or more, and POL-NS-05 is not engaged. The trace carrying this is impaired (weight 0.39; GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW, LOW_COVERAGE) and I disclose it. KEPT; The rider's exoneration route under POL-NS-04 cannot run at all: the chat log for this trip carries 0 messages and the trip record records no in-app calls, so limb (a) — a locating or coordinating message sent by the rider during the waiting window — is not met, and the silence interval limb (b) turns on never arises. KEPT; The trace carries no rider track at all — rider_fix_count 0, rider_presence.available false — so POL-NS-04 limb (c) is undecidable rather than failed, and under POL-NS-11 that undecidability cannot exonerate the rider; nor does the absent rider track impair the driver's own arrival and dwell evidence for POL-NS-01. DISCARDED; POL-NS-06's shortfall trigger does not engage: it fires only where the effective in-geofence dwell falls below the 180-second minimum, and on the primary arrival measure the dwell is 400 seconds. The separate accumulated-dwell block is the POL-NS-06 limb (i) accumulation tool and is unavailable on these facts, but the driver does not need it and does not assert it. DISCARDED; The fare ledger is clean and shows no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect: its cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 reconciles exactly with trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50, payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00 — so the fee the driver is asked to defend is the correct net figure. KEPT; With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee — SGD 3.60 — and the anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the 4 the clause requires, and 1 of 81 completed trips is far below the 0.08 ratio. KEPT; The outcome this record produces is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, not NO_ACTION: where compensation is paid the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd, and the rider's charge simply stands as the disposition of the fee under POL-NS-07. Reading POL-NS-07's 'the ruling on the fee is NO_ACTION' as the ruling value would be a misreading of POL-GEN-03. KEPT
